items.title: Joseph 'One Eyed Babe' Phillips Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: Celestine was playing first trumpet and Louis was playing the second trumpet in the Tuxedo band.

ctx.x: Celestine was playing first trumpet and Louis was playing the second trumpet in the Tuxedo band.
Mm-hmm. And who was in the band then?

items.title: Joseph 'One Eyed Babe' Phillips Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: I seen a priest, and I love him. He went in that fire and got a girl out there... That was Father Booth's natchez.

ctx.x: Yeah, they were scalded. Like in the oven. See, they was pumping that water and that just smothered. I seen a priest, and I love him. He went in that fire and got a girl out there, but she died. But he'd ministered a last sacrament to her. That was Father Booth's natchez. What's a baby doll dance anyhow? You know, the little short dressers. Oh. Was it like a club? Yeah, it was a club. They'd give a baby doll dance, and all the ladies had them short dresses out wide. You know, they called them baby dolls. Just…
Mm-hmm. I knew they had them in the city, but I never heard of them out in the natchez. Yeah, yeah.
